resources.string: Is this phone official?
Ask BTRC once before you buy or sell
See the IMEI
The IMEI is the phone\'s own 15-digit number. Dial *#06# and the phone shows it.
Dial *#06#
Or look in the phone\'s settings
The number on the screen should match the number printed on the box or the sticker. Match them once before you buy.
Type the IMEI here
IMEI, 15 digits
A phone with two SIM slots has two IMEIs. Either one can be checked.
Type the 15 digits the phone shows.
%1$s more digits to type
This number is not a valid IMEI. Check for a typing mistake.
The number is well-formed. Now ask BTRC.
Ask BTRC
Type the full IMEI first.
Write the SMS to 16002
Your SMS app opens with KYD and the IMEI already written. You press send. Your mobile operator may charge for the SMS. BTRC answers by SMS.
Two other ways. You type the IMEI again there.
Open the BTRC website
What the answer means
BTRC\'s SMS says whether this handset is valid in its register. If it says it is not, find out more before you buy. Only BTRC can give this answer. A well-formed number is not proof.
The IMEI stays on this phone. DeviceGPT does not read, store or send it. The check is done by BTRC.
